notes.note: Sannr client limitation (@sannr/sannr 0.1.0-alpha.10), reported in CodeTV preparation October 7–9, 2026; not a provider defect or a new execution: The client sends multipart file parts without explicit MIME types; the PNG edit probe was rejected as application/octet-stream. Confirm per-part MIME support in the client before attempting this route. Do not retry unchanged input or bypass a refusal. Source: BUGS.md / CLI-006; this package retains the authored summary, not private raw evidence.

Sannr client limitation (@sannr/sannr 0.1.0-alpha.10), reported in CodeTV preparation October 7–9, 2026; not a provider defect or a new execution: Multipart filenames are reduced to basenames. The tested skills upload required files under one top-level directory and failed. Confirm directory-preserving multipart support before attempting that upload; a plain SKILL.md basename does not meet the tested requirement. Source: BUGS.md / CLI-008; this package retains the authored summary, not private raw evidence.

Sannr client limitation (@sannr/sannr 0.1.0-alpha.10), reported in CodeTV preparation October 7–9, 2026; not a provider defect or a new execution: Double-brace eval/grader template strings were parsed as unresolved client placeholders and refused before traffic. Replacing a dynamic template with literal text changes the eval and is not an equivalent workaround. Confirm supported literal-template handling before building this workflow. Source: BUGS.md / CLI-005; this package retains the authored summary, not private raw evidence.

Sannr client limitation (@sannr/sannr 0.1.0-alpha.10), reported in CodeTV preparation October 7–9, 2026; not a provider defect or a new execution: The protocol CLI accepts at most 1 MiB of JSON input. A large inline image data URL exceeded this local limit. Use a smaller valid input or a supported uploaded-file workflow; this is a CLI input cap, not a provider API limit. Source: BUGS.md / CLI-007; this package retains the authored summary, not private raw evidence.

Sannr client limitation (@sannr/sannr 0.1.0-alpha.10), reported in CodeTV preparation October 7–9, 2026; not a provider defect or a new execution: The client regex guard can reject complex matches assertions while reporting an ordinary mismatch. For structured-output checks, use simple assertions and separately parse/validate JSON rather than treating that mismatch as proof the model returned invalid JSON. Source: BUGS.md / CLI-003; this package retains the authored summary, not private raw evidence.

Sannr client limitation (@sannr/sannr 0.1.0-alpha.10), reported in CodeTV preparation October 7–9, 2026; not a provider defect or a new execution: Captured placeholders are not substituted inside expect clauses. A literal comparison such as equals:{resourceId} can fail and stop a lifecycle chain before cleanup. Check existence/type and explicitly compare the captured ID separately; track created resources and run authorized cleanup even after a failed assertion. Source: BUGS.md / CLI-004; this package retains the authored summary, not private raw evidence.
